title: HydroSentry Topographical Sink
description: Structural schema for an urban depression sink derived from the 30-metre Copernicus Digital Elevation Model. All elevations and volumes use SI units (metres, cubic metres). Geohash zones are validated to the Delhi geographic prefix 'ttn'.

sink_id.description: Unique alphanumeric identifier for this sink.

coordinates.description: WGS-84 geographic coordinates of the sink invert point.

latitude.description: Decimal degrees North. MUST be specified with a minimum of 5 decimal places of precision (convention-enforced; multipleOf omitted to avoid IEEE-754 rounding errors).

longitude.description: Decimal degrees East. MUST be specified with a minimum of 5 decimal places of precision (convention-enforced; multipleOf omitted to avoid IEEE-754 rounding errors).

geohash_zone.description: Precision-6 geohash string. Must begin with the Delhi geographic prefix 'ttn'.

invert_elevation_m.description: Minimum basin bed elevation relative to EGM2008 sea level, in metres. Sourced from the Copernicus 30 m DEM.

catchment_area_sq_m.description: Surface area in square metres that funnels rainwater toward this sink.

runoff_coefficient.description: Dimensionless rational method runoff coefficient reflecting impervious urban concrete/asphalt surfaces.

critical_volume_capacity_m3.description: Volumetric water capacity in cubic metres prior to the 350 mm (35 cm) axle-drowning threshold.

baseline_drainage_rate_m3_per_hr.description: Continuous gravity-fed culvert clearance rate in cubic metres per hour under normal conditions.
